findings.title: Note says shipping VAT is missing, but the code already applies it
findings.why: The note says report 3 (no VAT on shipping) is not done. But `src/tax.ts` `shippingVat` and `src/pricing.ts` (`totalCents` includes `shippingTax`) already implement it. The note is wrong or misleading, and the plan title contradicts it.
